name: 19th-century English chart of the Gulf of Mexico (unattributed)
note: PROVENANCE IS WEAK: Commons gives no author, title or date, only 'Old map showing the Mexican phantom island Bermeja'. Chosen because it draws Bermeja larger than any other digitised chart found, with the island left blank inside hachured shoal rings. Replace if a properly attributed chart turns up — Santa Cruz's Islario of 1539 is the obvious one, but it does not appear to be on Commons.
